title: P1c fix round 2: recall() takes its hit budget and thresholds from the explicit root's pool.toml per call (configured_hits(root) actually used, cmd_index passes root), and index.md entries without query relevance score 0 and never count toward sufficiency, so cheaper layers cannot starve gotchas, bus and graph results (review T-0474)
spec:
Fix round 2 for T-0463 (P1c) on its branch task/T-0463 at 62d26f1 (after fix round 1 T-0473), addressing review T-0474 (two findings).
1. Budgets from the root (recall.py around 144): recall(query, *, root=None, budget_hits=None, min_score=None, budget_chars=None, ...) resolves None values per call from the resolved root's .orchestrator/pool.toml: [memory].budget_hits, min_score, budget_chars (the P1c table), falling back to [limits].recall_hits for budget_hits when [memory] is absent, then to the built-in defaults (8, 0.5, 6000); configured_hits(root) is the single reader and cmd_index passes the same root it resolved (never the import-time ROOT). Test: test_recall_budget_from_root_pool_toml (a temp root whose pool.toml sets [memory].budget_hits = 2: recall stops after two notes hits while the same fixture with budget_hits = 10 goes on to the bus layer).
2. Relevance (recall.py around 74, index_notes): an index.md entry that matches no query term scores 0, never max(1, s); only hits with score >= min_score count toward the sufficiency check (sum of qualifying hits >= budget_hits), and hits below min_score are returned last and flagged relevant=false so callers can drop them. Test: test_recall_index_entries_without_relevance_do_not_satisfy_budget (index.md with twenty unrelated entries and one gotcha and one bus result that match the query: notes layer is not sufficient on its own, the bus layer is consulted, and both matching hits come back first).
Keep every T-0463 and T-0473 test and all existing tests green; run the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh in the worktree and confirm exit 0; commit on task/T-0463's branch with the task id including both named tests; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: recall() resolves budget_hits, min_score and budget_chars from the explicit root's pool.toml per call; unrelated index entries score 0 and never count toward sufficiency
all T-0463 and T-0473 tests and existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
